lines.en: The commander butterfly skims the orchid leaves.
Its wings open and close.
Its flight is slow but wandering.
It loops once around the flowers.
A fine band runs along its wing edges.
It glides just over the grass.

lines.zh: 它忽然升起，避开一块石头
lines.en: It rises to clear a stone.
It pauses in the air.
It settles on a flower.
It lifts off for the next one.
It rides the wind a little way.
It circles the shade twice.

lines.zh: 它的翅每到低处就扇得急
lines.en: Its wings beat faster near the ground.
It returns to the same patch.

lines.zh: 它在一朵花上停得最久
lines.en: It lingers longest on one bloom.

lines.zh: 它慢慢地往高处的花去
lines.en: It drifts up toward higher flowers.
The butterfly spreads its wings on the flower.

lines.zh: 它的翅纹在日光下很清楚
lines.en: Its pattern shows clearly in the sun.
It folds its wings slowly.

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻敲着花瓣
lines.en: Its antennae tap the petals.
It coils its proboscis away.
It takes two steps along a petal.
It stops to bask.

lines.zh: 它的翅随着呼吸轻轻开合
lines.en: Its wings breathe open and shut.
A bee passes nearby.
It does not flee, only shifts.
It tips its wings to an angle.
It shakes the dew off its wings.
The butterfly rests, wings toward you.

lines.zh: 它飞到你的高度，绕了一圈
lines.en: It rises to your height and circles.
It lands on your cuff.
Its wings open and close slowly.

lines.zh: 它在你的手背上停了很久
lines.en: It stays on your hand a long while.
It is not afraid; it simply stays.

lines.zh: 它的触角碰了碰你的皮肤
lines.en: Its antennae touch your skin.

lines.zh: 它又飞起来，绕回到花上
lines.en: It flies up and returns to a flower.
It seems to have no interest in you.

lines.zh: 它落在你影子里的一块光上
lines.en: It lands on a lit patch inside your shadow.
The butterfly lurches in flight.
A small piece of wing edge tears.
It drops below the flower and climbs back.
It folds its wings in tight.
Its antennae curl inward.
It flies low and fast.
It hides under a leaf.

lines.zh: 翅粉落了一小片在手边
lines.en: A little wing dust scatters.
It tries again, wobbling.
It still heads for the flowers.
The butterfly heads for the orchids.
It circles the flower's heart twice.
It drops its proboscis into the flower.
It stays and drinks a long while.

lines.zh: 它在花瓣上慢慢换位置
lines.en: It edges around the petals.
Finished, it coils the proboscis up.

lines.zh: 它飞到同一丛的另一朵
lines.en: It moves to another bloom in the clump.
Its wings open and close slowly.

lines.zh: 它抖了一下，翅粉落了些
lines.en: It shivers and a little dust falls.
It seems to memorise this clump.
The butterfly bumps you and drifts off.
It dips and lifts again.
A wing brushes your hand.
It banks around you.
The air current pushes it sideways.

lines.zh: 它稳住，继续往花那边去
lines.en: It recovers and goes on toward the flowers.

lines.zh: 它的翅尖碰到你的鼻尖
lines.en: Its wingtip touches your nose.
It rests a moment on your shoulder.
Then it flies off.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子当成树荫
lines.en: It takes your shadow for tree shade.

lines.zh: 两只蛱蝶绕着飞成一个圈
lines.en: Two butterflies spiral around each other.

lines.zh: 它们一上一下，交替升降
lines.en: One rises as the other falls.

lines.zh: 它们的翅几乎同时扇动
lines.en: Their wings beat almost in time.
They settle on the same flower.

lines.zh: 它们的触角互相碰了一下
lines.en: Their antennae touch.

lines.zh: 它们在花瓣上并排停着
lines.en: They rest side by side on the petals.

lines.zh: 然后一只飞起，另一只跟着
lines.en: One lifts off; the other follows.

lines.zh: 它们绕着花丛飞了半圈
lines.en: They loop half around the patch.

lines.zh: 阳光把两只翅照得很亮
lines.en: The sun lights both pairs of wings.
They keep at it a long while.
The butterfly lands and unrolls its beak.

lines.zh: 它把口器探进花冠深处
lines.en: Its proboscis goes deep into the bloom.
It forgets to beat its wings.
It shifts angle and feeds again.
It grips the stamens firmly.

lines.zh: 它把卷好的口器收回去
lines.en: It rolls the proboscis back up.

lines.zh: 它对不是花的东西不理
lines.en: Anything but a flower it ignores.
It circles the flower once more.

lines.zh: 它落在旁边的叶上歇脚
lines.en: It rests on a leaf nearby.
It moves on to the next bloom.
The butterfly climbs and circles you.
It lands on a button at your shoulder.
It spreads its wings to the light.

lines.zh: 它忽然朝你的手飞下来
lines.en: It suddenly drops toward your hand.
It settles on your knuckle.
Its antennae keep probing.
It tries to get into your cuff.
Looking for flowers, it found you.
It circles your wrist.

lines.zh: 它在你皮肤上停住不动
lines.en: It stops still on your skin.

lines.zh: 蛱蝶在你身边绕来绕去
lines.en: The butterfly keeps circling you.

lines.zh: 它几次落在你身上又飞起
lines.en: It lands and lifts, again and again.

lines.zh: 它好像把你的手当成花
lines.en: It seems to take your hand for a flower.

lines.zh: 它的口器伸出来又卷回
lines.en: Its proboscis unrolls and rolls back.
It works between your fingers.
It rests on your cuff.
It edges along to your wrist.
Your sweat puzzles it.
It tries a small probe.
And then it flies away.
The butterfly bumps your face, lightly.

lines.zh: 它的翅粉沾在你的眼皮上
lines.en: Wing dust sticks to your eyelid.

lines.zh: 它绕着你的头连转两圈
lines.en: It loops twice around your head.

lines.zh: 它的足抓了一下你的鼻梁
lines.en: Its feet grip your nose briefly.
It lands by your ear and beats its wings.
It slips in at your collar.
It probes at your neck.
Your hand swats it away.
It comes straight back.
It hangs before you and will not leave.
A fleck of colour appears over the flowers.
The butterfly rises out of the leaves.
It loops once around the orchids.
Its wings go translucent in the sun.

lines.zh: 它落在一朵刚开的花上
lines.en: It settles on a newly opened bloom.
It opens and shuts its wings slowly.
The wind nudges it off line.
It corrects back on course.
It goes back and forth between blooms.

lines.zh: 它的翅影在草地上滑过
lines.en: Its wing shadow slides over the grass.

lines.zh: 翅一触火就卷，它直落下去
lines.en: Fire curls a wing and it drops.
It lands with a wing crumpled.
Soaked wings stick it to the surface.

lines.zh: 冲击把它抛得没了影子
lines.en: The blast flings it out of sight.
An arrow grazes a wing and tears it.
Odd force spins it in place.
Long unfed, its flight wanders.
A flash, and it curls up tight.

lines.zh: 虚空抽走空气，它落得很快
lines.en: The void draws off the air; it falls fast.
